checks: The native DirectComposition compact pill renders recorded GSMTC artwork; no WebView or provider polling is needed for the pill
The production native hit-gated handler accumulates two half-detents, applies +2 / Shift -1, and middle-click pauses the current recorded session
Transparent corners and fullscreen-hidden native hosts reject media gestures
Current release WebView2 uses actual Tauri media IPC, playback controls and session chips; paused radio omits its unsupported timeline and skip controls, with exact-repeat DPR2 captures
Resume replaces the injected subscription; all playback/audio calls are recorded and no real player, audio output or OS input is touched
scope: Owned custom-protocol release DirectComposition and WebView2, actual Tauri media IPC and native gesture handler, production media service with recorded MediaProvider. No live GSMTC/Core Audio, global input, OS display/audio settings, user profile or account.
